# function: appconfig_hostedconfigurationversion

Builds the ARN for `appconfig` `hostedconfigurationversion`:

```
arn:${Partition}:appconfig:${Region}:${Account}:application/${ApplicationId}/configurationprofile/${ConfigurationProfileId}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:appconfig:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:application/application-id/configurationprofile/configuration-profile-id
output "appconfig_hostedconfigurationversion" {
  value = provider::arn::appconfig_hostedconfigurationversion("application-id", "configuration-profile-id")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
appconfig_hostedconfigurationversion(application_id string, configuration_profile_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `application_id` (String) Value for `${ApplicationId}` in the ARN template.
1. `configuration_profile_id` (String) Value for `${ConfigurationProfileId}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
